title: 第891章 扫清南域
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

有大乌鸦、忘忧散人两个化神修士看着，又有韩榆的雷电之力禁制，本来有可能自爆或者因为泄露消息而身死的四洲小天地修士，一个也没死。

韩榆费了不少时间，仔细搜魂之后，又是一个夜晚到来。

饶是他元婴境界后期修为，神识有两处心海大千、两处神识作为依靠，如此短时间内接连搜魂，也不免感觉疲惫。

四洲小天地的风土人情、人际关系、灵物法宝等等虽然不是特别重要，但韩榆在搜魂中还是能够清晰感受到，四洲小天地用于辅助修行提升的灵物略少，显得更珍贵，用于炼制法宝的各类灵物则是明显更多，从金丹境界、元婴境界开始几乎每个修士都拥有一两件法宝，甚至更多。

最重要的当然还是韩榆通过战斗观察得到的宝贵经验。

五域小天地这边化神修士也就拥有一件法宝，极少有威力太强的化神境界法宝，而四洲小天地那边，化神修士拥有的法宝太多太实用了。

虽然本身实力未必有多强，但仅是依仗法宝的威力，实战威能便强了一截——譬如忘忧散人这样的化神修士，仓促间遇上一个四洲小天地化神修士，那绝对是要吃大亏的。

除此之外，最重要的消息便是，四洲小天地共有五位化神修士，流州老祖、紫云老祖、黄雀老祖、绿荷老祖，还有就是那灵宝阁的主人灵宝老祖。

韩榆搜魂完毕，将流明真人等众修士所有储物袋、法器、法宝尽数收拢到黑水吉祥宝瓮之中去。

流明真人跪在地上，心下忐忑不安。

其他众修士也都跪在地上，等候发落。

韩榆既然已经搜魂，对在场众人怎么也有基本了解。

流明真人与另一个元婴修士都是留不得的——流明真人来了南域两次，一旦回去还会给流州老祖效力，那元婴修士也是一样，回去还得再当对方手下，他们忠心耿耿对南域就是祸害，不能留。

还有一些心内不甘心，不服，等待时机的元婴境界以下修士，在千丝万缕搜魂法之下这种想法简直都是明摆着。

因此，韩榆看了一眼大乌鸦，神识已经将生死名单告知它。

大乌鸦点了点头，将流明真人与另一名元婴修士和其他十多人全部当场击杀，并利用吞噬天赋吞噬元气，继续培育墨鲤、大黑熊、灵鸦群。

韩榆只是看了一眼，心下喟叹复制之力还是太少。

灵兽们需要龙鳞龙身龙蜕、凤血梧桐、海虹灵鱼鱼鳔……鲁恽需要阴寒灵水……万春谷、灵剑宗需要修行灵物……

韩榆自己则是需要灵脉或者其他更精纯的大量灵液之类灵物……

content_en:
Page (1/3)

With the two god-transformation monks Da Wuwu and Wangyou Sanren watching, and Han Yu's lightning power restraining them, none of the Sizhou Xiaotiandi monks who might have self-destructed or died due to leaking the news did not die.

Han Yu spent a lot of time searching for souls carefully, and then another night came.

Even though he was in the late stage of the Nascent Soul realm, his spiritual consciousness had two great minds and two spiritual consciousnesses to rely on. He could not help but feel exhausted after searching for souls in such a short period of time.

Although the customs, interpersonal relationships, spiritual objects, magic weapons, etc. in Sizhou Xiaotiandi are not particularly important, Han Yu can still clearly feel during the soul search that Sizhou Xiaotiandi has slightly fewer spiritual objects used to assist in the improvement of practice, which are more precious. There are significantly more various kinds of spiritual objects used to refine magic weapons. Starting from the Golden Core Realm and Nascent Soul Realm, almost every monk has one or two magic weapons, or even more.

The most important thing is of course the valuable experience Han Yu gained through combat observation.

The god-transformation monks in the Five Domains Small World only have one magic weapon, and there are very few magic weapons that are too powerful in the god-transformation realm. However, in the Four Continents Small World, the god-transformation monks have too many magic weapons that are too practical.

Although his own strength may not be very strong, his actual combat power is much stronger just by relying on the power of the magic weapon. For example, if a god-transforming monk like Wangyou Sanren encounters a four-continent small world god-transforming monk in a hurry, he will definitely suffer a big loss.

In addition, the most important news is that there are five god-transformation monks in Sizhou Xiaotiandi, including Liuzhou ancestor, Ziyun ancestor, Huangque ancestor, Luhe ancestor, and the master of Lingbao Pavilion, Lingbao ancestor.

After Han Yu finished searching for souls, he collected all the storage bags, magic tools, and magic weapons of Master Lu Ming and other monks into the Black Water Auspicious Treasure Urn.

Master Lu Ming knelt on the ground, feeling uneasy.

The other monks also knelt on the ground, waiting for their fate.

Since Han Yu has already searched for souls, he has a basic understanding of everyone present.

Neither Master Lu Ming nor another Nascent Soul cultivator can be retained - Master Lu Ming has come to the Southern Territory twice. Once he returns, he will serve the Liuzhou Ancestor. The same goes for the Nascent Soul cultivator. He will have to be the other party's subordinate again when he returns. Their loyalty is a scourge to the Southern Territory and cannot be kept.

There are also some monks below the Nascent Soul realm who are unwilling and dissatisfied and are waiting for the opportunity. This idea is obvious under the myriad of soul-searching methods.

Therefore, Han Yu glanced at the big crow, and his spiritual consciousness had informed it of the list of life and death.

The big crow nodded, killed Master Lumen, another Nascent Soul cultivator, and more than a dozen others on the spot, and used his devouring talent to devour the vitality, and continued to cultivate the black carp, the big black bear, and the spirit crow group.

Han Yu just glanced at it and sighed in his heart that the power of copying was still too little.

The spiritual beasts need dragon scales, dragon bodies, dragon sloughs, phoenix blood sycamores, rainbow spirit fish swim bladders... Lu Yun needs Yinhan spiritual water... Wanchun Valley and Lingjian Sect need spiritual objects to practice...

Han Yu himself needs spiritual veins or other more pure spiritual fluids and other spiritual things...
